description: This file implements a cyclic buffer class for inter-process communication or data streaming, including methods for reading, writing, reserving space, locking, unlocking, and managing buffer state. It handles platform-specific synchronization primitives and manages internal buffer administration.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class providing a thread-safe, lockable, circular buffer for data exchange, supporting platform-specific synchronization and buffer management.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is valid and loads it if necessary.

methods.name: AdminLock
methods.description: Acquires the internal mutex for thread-safe administrative operations.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Virtual method called when data becomes available.

methods.name: Reevaluate
methods.description: Reevaluates buffer state and notifies waiting agents.

methods.name: Alert
methods.description: Sets an alert flag and reevaluates buffer state.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer into a provided buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer from a provided buffer.

methods.name: AssureFreeSpace
methods.description: Ensures there is enough free space in the buffer for a write.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for a future write.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, optionally waiting for data.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Peeks at data in the buffer without removing it.

methods.name: GetOverwriteSize
methods.description: Returns the size of data to overwrite during a write.

methods.name: GetReadSize
methods.description: Returns the size of data available to read.
